goal: Every session mc launches — claude or codex, step, mend, helper, intake, plan, brief, worker or work, new or resumed — is handed its role text and nothing the tool would load on its own: no CLAUDE.md, no AGENTS.md, no auto-memory.
Its prompt-cache TTL comes from its role: `step` and `mend` 5 minutes, every other role 1 hour, whatever the billing.
Cost estimates price cache writes at the TTL they were written with.
contract: Ruling 40 (`docs/project/mc/rulings.md` § 40). The TTL is the role's, never the billing's: nothing reads `billing` to choose it.

The switches reach a session through launch arguments, the channel the role text already uses — not through the spawned process environment, so the interactive and tmux launches carry them exactly like the headless ones.
A resumed session gets the switches too; only the role text is left off a resume, as today.
The tool allowlist, `--strict-mcp-config`, `--autocompact`, the role text and its assembly in `instructionsFor` are unchanged.
The repositories' CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and the memory directories are not edited or moved.
out_of_scope: The managed runtime under `src/adapters/managed-runtime/`, which renders its own settings and refuses `--settings` in its argv.
The price table's model rows (`PRICES` in `src/mc/prices.js`).
Editing memoro's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, or deleting any memory.

success_criteria.criterion: A claude step launch, new and resumed, carries `--settings` with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 and CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=5m; a codex one carries `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0`.
success_criteria.check: Unit tests on `headlessArgs` in tests/mc/run-plan.test.js assert the exact argument pairs for both tools, new and resume.

success_criteria.criterion: A plan, brief, worker or work launch carries the same claude settings with TTL 1h, new and resumed, in both the foreground and the tmux launch.
success_criteria.check: Unit tests on `openInWorkArea` and `launchCommand` (through `startInBackground`) in `src/mc/work-open.js` assert the `--settings` argument and its TTL.

success_criteria.criterion: `streamSummary` prices 5-minute cache writes at 1.25× input and 1-hour writes at 2×.
success_criteria.check: A unit test feeds `streamSummary` assistant events whose usage splits `cache_creation` between `ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` and `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` and asserts the cost.

steps.title: Role TTL and the launch switches, for both tools, at every launch
steps.done_when: Every claude launch mc makes (headlessArgs, openInWorkArea, launchCommand; new and resumed) carries `--settings` with the two DISABLE switches and the role's TTL, every codex launch carries `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0`, `step`/`mend` resolve to 5m and other roles to 1h, and `mc gate` is green.
instruction: The role's TTL. In `parseRole` (`src/mc/roles.js`) read a frontmatter key `cache` and return it as `cache: '5m'` when its value is exactly `5m`, otherwise `cache: '1h'` — a role without the key is one hour. Add `cache: 5m` to the frontmatter of `canon/roles/step.md` and `canon/roles/mend.md`, after `tools:`. No other role file gets the key.

The switches belong to the adapters, beside `modelArgs`/`effortArgs`. In `src/adapters/claude-code.js` export `sessionArgs({ cache = '1h' } = {})` returning `['--settings', JSON.stringify({ env: { CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS: '1', CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY: '1', CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL: cache, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL: cache } })]`. Verified in the planning session on claude 2.1.296: `--settings` with an `env` object applies all of these — the request then carries no CLAUDE.md, no MEMORY.md, no memory section in the system prompt, and writes `ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` for `5m`. In `src/adapters/codex.js` export `sessionArgs()` returning `['-c', 'project_doc_max_bytes=0']` (codex-cli 0.151.0 knows the key; 0 loads no AGENTS.md); codex has no TTL to choose and ignores `cache`.

Replace the constant `CACHE_TTL_MS` in both adapters with `cacheTtlMs(cache)`: claude returns 5 × 60 000 for `5m` and 60 × 60 000 otherwise; codex returns its existing 5-minute figure whatever it is given. Update the comment above each to say where the figure now comes from. `src/mc/run.js` imports both constants (lines ~110–111) for `recoveryOf` (~line 745): there, take the step role's `cache` (`deps.role('step')?.cache`, falling back to `'1h'`) and pass `ttlMs: adapter.cacheTtlMs(cache)` for the plan's tool. With 5m, `recoveryFor`'s warm window (`ttlMs - WARM_MARGIN_MS`, `src/mc/run-plan.js`) is zero, so an interrupted step is resumed or started fresh by its context size alone — intended; leave `WARM_MARGIN_MS` and `COLD_RESUME_MAX_TOKENS` as they are.

Headless launches. `headlessArgs` (`src/mc/run-plan.js`) takes a new `cache = '1h'` parameter and puts `...(adapter?.sessionArgs?.({ cache }) ?? [])` into all three returns: for codex before `...instr` in both the `exec resume` and `exec` lists (codex takes `-c` options before the positionals), for claude beside `--strict-mcp-config`. The resume path must carry it too. Pass `cache: role.cache` at every caller: `src/mc/run.js` (~line 2336 and the resume call ~line 2463, `role` from `deps.role(kind)` at ~line 2292), `src/mc/mend.js` (~line 255, the `mend` role), `src/mc/helper-turn.js` (~line 260, the `intake` role).

Interactive launches. `openInWorkArea` (`src/mc/work-open.js`) builds `args` at ~line 99: add a `cache = '1h'` option and append `...(launch.adapter?.sessionArgs?.({ cache }) ?? [])` to both the resume and the new argv — before the prompt positional on a new launch, and before the resume prompt on a resume (codex's `resume` takes options before its positional; see `resumeArgs` in `src/adapters/codex.js`). Do the same in `launchCommand` (~line 339, the tmux command `startInBackground` and `respawnInBackground` both use), both branches, before `task` is pushed; its `shellQuote` already quotes every element, so the JSON needs nothing more. `launchCommand`, `startInBackground` and `respawnInBackground` take the same `cache = '1h'` option. Callers that hold a role (`src/mc/commands/plan.js` ~line 147, `src/mc/commands/brief.js` ~line 50) pass `cache: role.cache`; the rest (`work.js`, `helper.js`) take the default.

The library line. In `canon/roles/_common.md`, after the paragraph that begins 'Read the code before you decide or ask', add: 'Nothing is loaded for you beyond this text — no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or memory. A repository's `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/technical/`, and the notes under `~/.claude/projects/*/memory/`, are a library: `Grep` them when the work touches what they cover; never read one whole.'

Docs. In `docs/technical/mc-run.md`, the argument block under 'The two argument lists are the only place the tools differ' gets `--settings <env>` on the claude line and `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0` on the codex line, and one paragraph after it says what the settings carry, that the TTL is the role's (`cache:` in the frontmatter; ruling 40), and that resumed launches carry them too.

Tests. In `tests/mc/run-plan.test.js` assert `headlessArgs` for claude new and resume with `cache: '5m'` contains the `--settings` pair whose parsed `env` has the four keys and `5m`, and the default gives `1h`; for codex new and resume, `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0` precedes the prompt/session positional. Add `parseRole` cases (`cache: 5m` → `5m`, missing or other → `1h`) and assert the canon `step` and `mend` roles read `5m` and `plan` reads `1h`. Add `openInWorkArea` and `startInBackground` cases for new and resumed claude launches. Fix every existing test that pinned the old argv or imported `CACHE_TTL_MS`.

steps.title: Price cache writes by their TTL
steps.done_when: `estimateCost` prices 5-minute writes at 1.25× and 1-hour writes at 2× input, `streamSummary` hands it the split from each message's `usage.cache_creation`, a test asserts both, and `mc gate` is green.
instruction: `src/mc/prices.js`: replace `CACHE_WRITE_FACTOR` with `CACHE_WRITE_5M_FACTOR = 1.25` and `CACHE_WRITE_1H_FACTOR = 2`, and give `estimateCost` two more inputs, `cacheWrite5m` and `cacheWrite1h`. When either is given, price them at their factors and ignore `cacheWrite`; when neither is, price `cacheWrite` at 2 as today (a usage line without the split is the 1-hour claude default). Rewrite the header comment: the factor follows the TTL the write carried, and since ruling 40 the TTL is the role's.

`streamSummary` (`src/mc/run-plan.js`): while summing `modelUsage` per model, also sum `u.cache_creation?.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` and `u.cache_creation?.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` into `cacheWrite5mTokens` / `cacheWrite1hTokens` on the model's entry, and pass them to `estimateCost`. Keep `cacheCreationInputTokens` as it is; nothing else reads the new fields.

Tests in `tests/mc/run-plan.test.js`: a stream with one model's messages writing 1 000 tokens at 5m and 1 000 at 1h prices them at 1.25 and 2 times that model's input price; a stream whose usage has no `cache_creation` prices `cache_creation_input_tokens` at 2 as before. `grep -rn CACHE_WRITE_FACTOR src tests scripts` must come back empty.
